You are being evaluated on Continual-ARC, a lifelong stream of ARC-style grid puzzles.
Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:
  {"action": "submit", "grid": [[0, 1, 2], [3, 4, 5]]}   submit an output grid
  {"action": "request_demos"}                            ask for one more demonstration pair for this task
  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

    return (H,W,bg,mcol)

def f(gi):
    gi=[r[:] for r in gi]; H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    d=info(gi)
    bset=d['band']; mset=set(d['marks']); horiz=d['horiz']; bg=d['bg']
    ms=sorted(mset)
    # find marker line direction
    dirs=set()
    for i in range(len(ms)):
        for j in range(i+1,len(ms)):
            a,b=ms[i],ms[j]
            dx,dy=b[0]-a[0],b[1]-a[1]
            g_=dx//abs(dx) if dx else 0; h_=dy//abs(dy) if dy else 0
            dirs.add((g_,h_))
    s=min(ms,key=lambda p:min(abs(p[0]-q[0]) if horiz else abs(p[1]-q[1]) for q in bset))
    base=(s[0]-ms[0][0], s[1]-ms[0][1])
    # normalize direction along line
    import math
    def norm(v):
        x,y=v
        if x==0 and y==0: return None
        if x!=0: return (1 if x>0 else -1, 0)
        return (0, 1 if y>0 else -1)
    d0=norm(base)
    dr,dc=d0
    cur=s; painted=set(); stack=[d0]
    while stack:
        ndir=stack.pop()
        nr,nc=cur[0]+ndir[0],cur[1]+ndir[1]
        if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): continue
        if (nr,nc) in bset:
            if horiz: ndir=(-ndir[0],ndir[1])
            else: ndir=(ndir[0],-ndir[1])
            if ndir==d0: continue
            stack.append(ndir)
            cur=cur
            continue
        if gi[nr][nc]!=bg:
            # try alternate direction if any
            alt=[nd for nd in dirs if nd!=d0]
            if alt and len(stack)>0 and alt[0]==d0: stack.discard(d0)
            continue
        gi[nr][nc]=3; painted.add((nr,nc)); cur=(nr,nc)
    return gi
for n in [1,2,3]:
    print(n, f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])

def analyze(n):
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']; go=G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=dict(Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common())
    bgv,bandv,mkv=cnt.most_common()
    print('pair',n,'H,W',H,W,'colors',bgv,bandv,mkv)
    # markers
    Mk=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==mkv]
    Bs=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]==bandv]
    brs={r for r,_ in Bs}; bcs={c for _,c in Bs}
    print('markers',Mk)
    print('painted',[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if gi[i][j]!=go[i][j]])
    print('band rows',sorted(brs),'cols',sorted(bcs))
    return gi,go,Mk,Bs

def f(gi):
    gi=[r[:] for r in gi]; H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cmo=Counter(x for r in gi for x in r).most_common()
    bgv,bandv,mkv=cmo[0][0],cmo[1][0],cmo[2][0]
    Bs={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]==bandv}
    M=sorted((r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]==mkv)
    nbs=len({q[0] for q in Bs}); ncs=len({q[1] for q in Bs})
    horiz = (ncs<W and nbs>H//2) or (ncs==W)
    def dist(p): return min(abs(p[0]-q[0])+abs(p[1]-q[1]) for q in Bs)
    endc=min(M,key=dist)
    others=[p for p in M if p!=endc]
    # initial dir: away from the other markers along the line
    o=others[0]
    da=int((endc[0]-o[0])/max(1,abs(endc[0]-o[0])))
    db=int((endc[1]-o[1])/max(1,abs(endc[1]-o[1])))
    cur=endc
    while True:
        nr,nc=cur[0]+da,cur[1]+db
        if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): break
        if gi[nr][nc]==bandv:
            d=(-da,db) if horiz else (da,-db)
            continue
        if gi[nr][nc]==mkv: break
        if gi[nr][nc]==bgv:
            gi[nr][nc]=3; cur=(nr,nc)
    return gi
for n in [1,2,3]:
    print(n, f(G[f'Demo pair {n} input'])==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'])

G=load()
def solve(G):
    H=len(G); W=len(G[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in G for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # band = large horizontal run of a single non-bg value spanning full width
    def band_row(i):
        v=G[i][0]
        return all(x==v for x in G[i])
    bands=[i for i in range(H) if band_row(i)]
    assert len(bands)==1, bands
    b=bands[0]; vb=G[b][0]
    # stroke cells
    stroke=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j,x in enumerate(G[i]) if x not in (bg,vb) and not band_row(i)]
    # direction away from band: stroke is on one side; extend along stroke's dominant axis
    import collections
    sides=set(i for i,j in stroke)-{b}
    di=sum(s>b for s in sides)-sum(s<b for s in sides)
    # extend each stroke cell along its row (if horizontal-ish?) use dominant per-cell direction
    res=[r[:] for r in G]
    for i,j in stroke:
        # determine per-stroke-cell direction along band-normal
        # axis: stroke runs parallel to band -> extend perpendicular
        dsign=di
        r=i+dsign
        while 0<=r<H and not band_row(r):
            res[r][j]=3
            r+=dsign
    return res

def solve(G):
    H=len(G); W=len(G[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in G for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    b=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(G[i]))==1 and G[i][0]!=bg][0]
    vb=G[b][0]
    stroke=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j,x in enumerate(G[i]) if x!=bg and x!=vb]
    # vertex: stroke cell whose diagonal extension first reaches the band
    def dist_to_band(p):
        r,c=p
        # try both diagonal directions
        best=None
        for dr,dc in [(-1,-1),(1,1),(-1,1),(1,-1)]:
            n=k=0
            p=r,c
            while True:
                nr,nc=p[0]+dr,p[1]+dc
                if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): break
                if G[nr][nc]==vb: return k
                k+=1
                p=nr,nc
        return None
    v=min(stroke,key=lambda p:(dist_to_band(p) or 10**9))
    res=[r[:] for r in G]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if abs(r-v[0])==abs(c-v[1]):
                if G[r][c]==bg: res[r][c]=3
    return res
print(solve(G['Demo pair 4 input'])==G['Demo pair 4 output'])
out=solve(G['Test input'])
for r in out: print(''.join(map(str,r)))

def solve(G):
    H=len(G); W=len(G[0])
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in G for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    b=[i for i in range(H) if len(set(G[i]))==1 and G[i][0]!=bg][0]
    vb=G[b][0]
    stroke=set((i,j) for i in range(H) for j,x in enumerate(G[i]) if x!=bg and x!=vb)
    res=[r[:] for r in G]
    # beam direction toward band
    if min(stroke,key=lambda p:abs(p[0]-b))[0]>b: d=(1,0)   # vertical, downward
    else: d=(-1,0)
    sr,sc=min(stroke,key=lambda p:(p[0]<b))   # start from stroke end nearer band
    def march(i,j,dr,dc):
        nr,nj=i+dr,j+dc
        painted=[]
        while 0<=nr<H and 0<=nj<W:
            v=G[nr][nj]
            if v==vb:
                dr,dc=-dr,-dc   # reflect
                nr,nj=i+dr,j+dc
                continue
            if (nr,nj) in stroke: break
            if v==bg: painted.append((nr,nj)); i,j=nr,nj
            else: break
        return painted
    # incident: paint from stroke end toward band
    p=march(sr,sc,d[0],d[1])
    for q in p: res[q[0]][q[1]]=3
    # reflected tail
    dr,dc=d; nr,nj=sr+dr,sc+dc
    while 0<=nr<H and 0<=nj<W:
        v=G[nr][nj]
        if v==vb: dr,dc=-dr,-dc; nr,nj=nj-dc,0  # skip; redo step
        if (nr,nj) in stroke: break
        if v==bg: res[nr][nj]=3
        else: break
        nr+=dr; nj+=dc
    return res

def solve2(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in gi]
    pts=sorted([(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]!=6])
    def trace(p,d):
        r,c=p; dr,dc=d
        while True:
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): return
            v=gi[nr][nc]
            if v==6 or v==gi[r][c] or True:
                out[nr][nc]=3
                r,c=nr,nc
            else:
                # reflect: flip component(s) to find free bg step
                best=None
                opts=[]
                if 0<=nr+dr<H and 0<=nc+dc<W and gi[nr+dr][nc+dc]==6: opts.append((1,1))
                if gi[nr+dr][nc+dc]!=6 and gi[nr+dr][nc+dc]==gi[r][c]:
                    if 0<=nc-dc>=0 and gi[nr][nc-dc]==6: opts.append((1,-1))
                    if 0<=nc+dc<W and gi[nr][nc+dc]==6: opts.append((-1,1))
                    opts.append((-1,-1))
                best=min(opts,key=lambda o:o[0]*o[1])
                if best is None: return
                dr,dc=best
                r,c=r+dr,c+dc
    # shape direction: points sorted give dr,dc; beam goes reverse from first point AND forward? In demo: from (14,21) going up-left reversed; from (20,27)? nothing extra beyond. Just emit from both ends along reverse direction of sorted shape dir
    d=(pts[-1][0]-pts[0][0]>0, pts[-1][1]-pts[0][1]>0)
    for start in [pts[0],pts[-1]]:
        trace(start,(-d[0],-d[1]))
    return out

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    vals=[v for row in gi for v in row]
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(vals); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    bands={r for r in range(H) if len(set(gi[r]))==1 and gi[r][0]!=bg}
    mark=[v for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]!=bg and r not in bands]
    mset=set(mark); marks=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c] in mset]
    # line dir
    d=(marks[-1][0]-marks[0][0], marks[-1][1]-marks[0][1])
    sg=(1 if d[0]>0 else -1, 1 if d[1]>0 else -1)
    ext=[]
    def trace(sgn,d):
        p=marks[0] if sgn[0]==sgn[0] else marks[-1]
        t=p[0]+sgn[0]; cc=p[1]+sgn[1]
        while 0<=t<H and 0<=cc<W:
            if gi[t][cc]!=bg: break
            ext.append((t,cc)); t+=sgn[0]; cc+=sgn[1]
    trace((sg[0],sg[1]),d); trace((-sg[0],-sg[1]),(-d[0],-d[1]))
    out=[row[:] for row in gi]
    for r,c in ext: out[r][c]=3
    pts=set(ext)
    for (r,c) in ext:
        dirs=[(sg[0],-sg[1]),(-sg[0],sg[1])]
        ok=False
        for dd in dirs:
            t,r_=r+dd[0]; c_,cc=c+dd[1]
            if 0<=r_<=H and 0<=cc<=W and gi[r_][cc]==bg:
                t,r2=r+r_; cc,c2=c+cc
                while 0<=t<H and 0<=cc<W and gi[t][cc]==bg:
                    out[t][cc]=3; t+=dd[0]; cc+=dd[1]
                ok=True
        if ok: pass
    return out

    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in gi for v in row)

    markcolors=set()
    for r in range(H):

            markcolors.add(gi[r][0])
    mc=[c for c in markcolors if c!=bg]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c] in mc]
    out=[row[:] for row in gi]
    d=(pts[-1][0]-pts[0][0], pts[-1][1]-pts[0][1])
    sg=(1 if d[0]>0 else -1, 1 if d[1]>0 else -1)
    def step(p,s,d):
        t,r_,cc=p[0]+sg[0]*s,p[1]+sg[1]*s
        while 0<=t<H and 0<=cc<W and gi[t][cc]==bg:
            out[t][cc]=3; t+=sg[0]; cc+=sg[1]
    p=pts[0]
    # forward (down-right)
    step((p[0],p[1]),1,d)
    # backward (up-left), bouncing at blockers
    t,r_,cc=p[0]-sg[0],p[1]-sg[1]
    while 0<=t<H and 0<=cc<W and gi[t][cc]==bg:
        out[t][cc]=3; t-=sg[0]; cc-=sg[1]

            sg=opts[0]

        else:
            t-=sg[0]; cc-=sg[1]

    def paint(r_,cc):

import numpy as np
from collections import Counter

def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def thinfo(comp):
    rs=[p[0] for p in comp]; cs=[p[1] for p in comp]
    return min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)

# classify each non-bg component: stripe (full-width/horizontal, or full-height/vertical) or marker
class Obj:
    def __init__(self,comp,v):
        self.comp=set(comp); self.v=v
        r0,r1,c0,c1=thinfo(comp)
        self.hspan = (r1-r0+1)==(max(r0,r1)+1) and (c1-c0+1)==W
        self.vspan = (c1-c0+1)==W and (r1-r0+1)==H
        self.is_strip = (r1==r0) or (c1==c0)
        if self.is_strip:
            horiz = (r1==r0)  # horizontal band
            vert  = (c1==c0)
            self.orientation = 'h' if horiz else ('v' if vert else None)
        else:
            self.orientation=None
            # marker if diagonal line
            pts=sorted(comp)
            self.diag = (len(pts)>=2 and abs(pts[0][0]-pts[-1][0])==abs(pts[0][1]-pts[-1][1]))
    @property
    def cells(self): return self.comp

def solve(i, verbose=False):
    i=np.array(i); H,W=i.shape
    cnt=Counter(i.flatten()); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    objs=[]
    for v,n in cnt.items():
        if v==bg: continue
        for comp in comps_of(i,{v}):
            o=Obj(set(comp),v); objs.append(o)
    # find marker (non-strip diagonal comp)
    markers=[o for o in objs if o.is_strip==False and o.orientation is None and (o.hspan or o.vspan)]
    if not markers: markers=objs  # fallback
    painted=set()
    res=i.copy()
    def ray(start,d):
        pos=start; d=d
        steps=0; seen=set()
        while steps<H+W and pos in seen and True:
            q=pos[d]
            if not (0<=q<H and 0<=pos[1]+d[1]<W): break
            q=(pos[0]+d[0],pos[1]+d[1])
            if not (0<=q[0]<H and 0<=q[1]<W): break
            if q in (tuple(c) for c in []): pass
            rr,cc=q
            if i[rr,cc]==bg:
                painted.add((rr,cc)); res[rr,cc]=3; pos=q; continue
            if i[rr,cc]==obj_v(marker_v): pass
            # non-bg: bounce if stripe, absorb if marker
            # find owner object
            own=[ob for ob in objs if ob.comp==(rr,cc)]
            if not own: pos=q; continue
            ob=own[0]
            if ob.is_strip and ob.orientation:
                nd = (-d[0],d[1]) if ob.orientation=='h' else (d[0],-d[1])
                pos=q; d=nd; continue
            else:  # marker: absorb
                pos=q; break
        return
    results={}
    def sim(start,d):

import numpy as np, json
from collections import Counter

def comps_of(g):
    g=np.array(g); H,W=g.shape
    bg=Counter(g.flatten()).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=np.zeros((H,W),bool); out=[]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if g[r,c]!=bg and not seen[r,c]:
                st=[(r,c)];seen[r,c]=True;cells=set()
                while st:
                    rr,cc=st.pop();cells.add((rr,cc))
                    for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=rr+dr,cc+dc
                        if 0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W and not seen[nr,nc] and g[nr,nc]!=bg:
                            seen[nr,nc]=True;st.append((nr,nc))
                out.append(cells)
    return out,bg

def solve(gi):
    gi=[row[:] for row in gi]; H=len(gi); W=len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps,bg_=comps_of(gi)
    bars=[c for c in comps if len(c)>1]; marks=sorted(min(c) for c in comps if len(c)==1)
    sim=[row[:] for row in gi]
    barmask=set(bars[0]); rs=[p[0] for p in barmask]; cs=[p[1] for p in barmask]
    rb0,rb1=min(rs),max(rs); cb0,cb1=min(cs),max(cs)
    
    def walk(dr,dc):
        # beam from marker set along dir; paints bg cells until non-bg cell; may reflect once if next cell is bar
        r,c=marks[0]; painted=set(); flipped=False
        for _ in range(2*(H+W)+4):
            nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
            if not (0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): break
            v=(nr,nc)
            if v in barmask:
                if flipped: break
                prev=(r,c)
                horiz = (prev[0]==rb1 or prev[0]==rb0) if False else None
                # face type from which extent prev is OUTSIDE relative to bar
                vert_outside = prev[1]<cb0 or prev[1]>cb1   # true => hit vertical face -> flip dc
                horz_inside = rb0<=prev[0]<=rb1
                hr_out = prev[0]<rb0 or prev[0]>rb1
                if hr_out and vert_outside: d=(-dr,-dc)       # corner
                elif hr_out: d=(-dr,dc)                      # horizontal face
                else: d=(dr,-dc)                             # vertical face
                dr,dc=d; flipped=True; continue
            if gi[nr][nc]!=bg: break
            if gi[nr][nc]==bg: painted.add((nr,nc))
            r,c=nr,nc
        return painted
    def walk_end(start, oth):
        dr=1 if oth[0]>start[0] else -1; dc=1 if oth[1]>start[1] else -1
        return walk(dr,dc)
    painted=set()
    for i in range(len(marks)):
        a,b=marks[i],marks[-1]
        for start,oth in [(a,b),(b,a)]:
            cand=walk_end(start,oth)
            if cand: painted |= cand
    for r,c in painted: sim[r][c]=3
    return sim

# test demos
for k in ['Demo pair 4','Demo pair 5','Demo pair 6','Demo pair 7']:
    ok=solve(G[k+' input'])==G[k+' output']
    print(k,ok)

import numpy as np, json
from collections import Counter

def solve(gi):
    gi=[row[:] for row in gi]; H=len(gi); W=len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in gi for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    comps,bg_=comps_of(gi)
    bars=[c for c in comps if len(c)>1]; marks=sorted(min(c) for c in comps if len(c)==1)
    barmask=set(bars[0])
    rs=[p[0] for p in barmask]; cs=[p[1] for p in barmask]
    rb0,rb1=min(rs),max(rs); cb0,cb1=min(cs),max(cs)
    def dist(p): return min(abs(p[0]-q) for q in rs)+min(abs(p[1]-q) for q in cs)
    src=min(marks,key=dist)
    out=[row[:] for row in gi]; painted=set()
    dirs=[]
    if len(marks)>=2:
        oth=marks[-1]
        d=(1 if oth[0]>src[0] else -1, 1 if oth[1]>src[1] else -1)
        dirs.append((d,(-d[0],-d[1])))
    else:
        dirs=[(dd,) for dd in [(1,-1),(-1,1),(1,1),(-1,-1)] if (0<=src[0]+dd[0]<H and 0<=src[1]+dd[1]<W)]
    # also add perpendiculars for 2+mark case? demo6 needed a horiz ray from top end. Treat 2-mark case generally: try line dirs + perps of the nearer mark
    res=set()
    for m in marks+[src]:
        if len(marks)>=2 and m==src and False: pass
        perps = None
        for dd in [(1,-1),(-1,1),(1,1),(-1,-1)]:
            rr,cc=m[0]+dd[0],m[1]+dd[1]
            if not(0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W): continue
            if (rr,cc) in barmask: continue
            if gi[rr][cc]==bg: res.add((rr,cc))
    if len(marks)>=2:
        # along line from source end only
        t=0; r,c=src; best=None
        while True:
            nr,nc=r+d[0],c+d[1]
            if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): break
            if (nr,nc) in barmask: break
            if gi[nr][nc]==bg: res.add((nr,nc)); r,c=nr,nc; t+=1
        t=0; r,c=src
        while True:
            nr,nc=r-d[0],c-d[1]
            if not(0<=nr<H and 0<=nc<W): break
            if (nr,nc) in barmask: break
            if gi[nr][nc]==bg: res.add((nr,nc)); r,c=nr,nc; t+=1
    for r,c in res: out[r][c]=3
    return out
